metaDescription: How Virtanex Labs collects, uses, and protects personal data when you visit this website or contact us, in line with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
title: Privacy Policy
intro: This policy explains what personal data {company} collects through this website, why we collect it, how long we keep it, and the rights you have under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR, Regulation (EU) 2016/679) and the Finnish Data Protection Act. We keep data collection to the minimum needed to answer your messages and to run a secure website.

sections.title: 1. Who is responsible for your data
paragraphs: The data controller is {company}, a Finland-based software and IT company. You can reach us about anything in this policy at {email}.
We have not appointed a Data Protection Officer because our processing is small in scale. Privacy questions and requests go to the address above and are handled by our management.

sections.title: 2. What data we collect and why
paragraphs: We collect personal data only in the situations below. We do not run advertising, profiling, or analytics tools on this website.
items: Project inquiry form: your name, email address, company (optional), the service and timeline you choose, and the message you write. We use it to answer your inquiry and to prepare a proposal. Legal basis: steps taken at your request before entering into a contract (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR) and our legitimate interest in replying to business inquiries (Article 6(1)(f)).

Discovery call request: your name, email address, the topic and meeting window you choose, and optional notes. We use it to schedule and prepare the call. Legal basis: Article 6(1)(b) and Article 6(1)(f) GDPR.
Email you send us directly: the address, content, and any attachments, used to correspond with you. Legal basis: Article 6(1)(b) or 6(1)(f) GDPR.

Technical and security data: when you load a page or submit a form, our hosting infrastructure processes your IP address and request details (browser type, pages requested, time) in server logs, and the form limits repeated submissions per IP address using short-lived memory that is cleared within minutes. We use this to deliver the site, prevent abuse, and keep it secure. Legal basis: legitimate interest (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR).

Language selection: the hosting network may derive your approximate country from your IP address so that we can show the site in a suitable language. We use it only for that moment and do not store it.

sections.title: 3. Providing your data is voluntary
paragraphs: You are not required to submit any form. If you do, the name and email fields are needed so that we can reply. Please do not include sensitive information (for example health data) or confidential business secrets in your message. If a project requires it, we will agree on a secure channel and a non-disclosure agreement first.

sections.title: 4. Cookies and local storage
paragraphs: This website does not use analytics, advertising, or tracking cookies, so no cookie consent banner is needed. It stores two small preferences that you choose yourself and that are needed for the features you asked for:
items: NEXT_LOCALE cookie: remembers the language you pick with the language selector. It is set only when you change the language, lasts one year, and is never used for tracking.
Local storage entry "theme": remembers whether you chose dark mode. It stays on your device only and is never sent to us.

sections.title: 5. Who receives your data
paragraphs: We do not sell your data. We share it only with service providers that act on our behalf and are bound by data protection terms (processors), and only as far as needed:
items: Email service: inquiries sent through the forms are delivered to our business mailbox, which is provided by Google (Gmail / Google Workspace).
Hosting and network infrastructure: the provider that serves this website and may process technical data such as IP addresses in server logs.

Image delivery: some photographs on this site are loaded from the Unsplash image network (images.unsplash.com). Your browser connects to that service to fetch the images, so it can see your IP address and browser details. We do not send it any other data.
Authorities, advisers, or courts, where we are legally required to disclose data or need to protect our legal rights.

sections.title: 6. Transfers outside the EU/EEA
paragraphs: Some providers named above, such as Google, may process data in the United States or other countries outside the EU/EEA. Where this happens we rely on an adequacy decision of the European Commission (for example the EU-US Data Privacy Framework for certified companies) or on the Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the Commission, together with additional safeguards where needed. You can ask us for details at {email}.

sections.title: 7. How long we keep data
paragraphs: We keep data only as long as we need it for the purpose it was collected:
items: Inquiries and call requests: for as long as needed to handle your request, and normally deleted within 24 months after our last contact if no contract results.

If we start working together: project and contract records are kept for the duration of the engagement and afterwards for as long as the law requires (for example accounting records) or to defend legal claims.
Server logs: kept for a short period, normally no longer than 30 days.
Rate-limit data: held in memory for about 10 minutes and then discarded.

sections.title: 8. Your rights
paragraphs: Under the GDPR you have the following rights. To use any of them, write to {email}. We will answer within one month. We may ask you to confirm your identity first.
items: Access: to receive confirmation of whether we process your data and a copy of it.
Rectification: to have inaccurate or incomplete data corrected.
Erasure: to have your data deleted where there is no longer a reason to keep it.
Restriction: to ask us to pause processing in certain cases.
Data portability: to receive data you gave us in a structured, commonly used format where processing is based on a contract.
Objection: to object at any time to processing based on our legitimate interests, on grounds relating to your situation.
Withdraw consent: where we rely on your consent, you may withdraw it at any time without affecting earlier processing.

Complaint: to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority. In Finland this is the Office of the Data Protection Ombudsman (tietosuoja.fi). You may also contact the authority in the EU country where you live or work.

sections.title: 9. Automated decisions
paragraphs: We do not use automated decision-making or profiling that produces legal or similarly significant effects on you.

sections.title: 10. Security
paragraphs: The website is served over an encrypted HTTPS connection. Access to the mailbox that receives inquiries is limited to people who need it, and access credentials are kept outside the website code. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, but we work to protect your data against loss, misuse, and unauthorised access.

sections.title: 11. Children
paragraphs: This website is intended for businesses and professionals and is not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect personal data from anyone under 16.

sections.title: 12. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy when our practices or the law change. The date at the top shows the latest version. If a change significantly affects how we use your data, we will make that clear on this page.
